author: Michael Schofield
why: Recognisable Ko Tapu needle rising from green water, with distant forested islands and blue sky; compact landmark suits a near-square crop.

author: Sven
why: Phang Nga Bay aerial with layered limestone islands, mangroves and blue-green water; broad landscape alternative.

author: Gergana Ivanova
why: Classic James Bond Island view framed by larger forested cliffs, with emerald water and a central needle; softer, hazier light.
